description: In-game Bestiary/Codex (I10). References foes by `id` into monsters.json (name, sprite, svgCode, stats all resolve from there) and only authors the player-facing reading aids: `role`, `tier`, `silhouette` (what to look for) and `telegraph` (how to react). A foe appears in the codex only after it has been defeated, so nothing here spoils an unencountered opponent. Game Designer owns this copy; Tech Lead owns the schema + `codex-system.js`. Adding a foe needs a monsters.json entry plus a codex entry here (dispatch-table driven, no JS branches).

chaser.name: Chaser
chaser.summary: Closes the distance and attacks in melee. Kite it or meet it head-on.

zoner.name: Zoner
zoner.summary: Holds its spacing and strikes from range. Close the gap or break line of sight.

artillery.name: Artillery
artillery.summary: Fires telegraphed shots from afar. Dodge on the wind-up and punish the recovery.

charger.name: Charger
charger.summary: Winds up, then lunges in a straight line. Step off the trail, then counter.

bomber.name: Bomber
bomber.summary: Marks ground, then detonates an area. Leave the marked tile before it lands.

summoner.name: Summoner
summoner.summary: Calls reinforcements. Prioritise it before the field fills up.

elite.name: Elite
elite.summary: A named, tougher foe with a signature move.

boss.name: Boss
boss.summary: A tower's final guardian. Learn its patterns.

giant_rat.silhouette: Low, lean shape that skitters straight at you.
giant_rat.telegraph: No wind-up. Backpedal while you strike and it cannot close.

crypt_skeleton.silhouette: Rattling upright frame with a raised arm.
crypt_skeleton.telegraph: Steady, unhurried approach; punish the gap between its swings.

shadow_cultist.silhouette: Hooded robed figure that keeps its distance.
shadow_cultist.telegraph: Casts from three to four tiles; close in to break the pattern.

elite_cultist.silhouette: Taller robed caster with a heavier stance.
elite_cultist.telegraph: Tighter standoff and harder hits; commit to the gap between casts.

abyssal_overlord.silhouette: Crowned, towering silhouette that fills the room.
abyssal_overlord.telegraph: Relentless pursuit; keep moving and answer only after its swings.

cinder_acolyte.telegraph: Hurls ember bolts; sidestep on the throw and dash the caster.

grave_charger.silhouette: Hunched skeletal runner, coiled to spring.
grave_charger.telegraph: Short wind-up then a straight dash; step aside and strike the recovery.

plague_bomber.silhouette: Bloated cultist holding a bubbling flask.
plague_bomber.telegraph: Marks a green pool before it bursts; clear the tile on the wind-up.

bone_summoner.silhouette: Caster with a bone focus and dark ritual stance.
bone_summoner.telegraph: Raises reinforcements; burst it down before the field fills.

mire_hound.telegraph: Wind-up then a fast straight pounce; dodge sideways, not backward.

rime_acolyte.silhouette: Frost-rimed caster with a pale glow.
rime_acolyte.telegraph: Fires frost shards in a line; weave between shots and close.

sepulcher_mortar.telegraph: Long, loud wind-up; leave the orange mark well before it lands.

chime_wraith.silhouette: Drifting spectral form with a tolling bell.
chime_wraith.telegraph: Rings a purple zone; keep moving so you are never on the mark.

barrow_knight.silhouette: Armoured revenant with a raised blade.
barrow_knight.telegraph: Charges, then stamps an earth-shudder zone; dodge twice, not once.

ossuary_priest.silhouette: Priest clutching a tome, ringed by motes.
ossuary_priest.telegraph: Summons and snipes; silence it early or you will be surrounded.

brine_witch.silhouette: Hunched figure wreathed in bubbling brine.
brine_witch.telegraph: Lobs slow hexes; use the travel time to reposition or close.

tidebound_king.silhouette: Crowned colossus wreathed in rising water.
tidebound_king.telegraph: Tidal slams mark the floor and it calls reinforcements; keep moving and thin the adds.

forgemaster_kol.silhouette: Massive smith with a raised hammer.
forgemaster_kol.telegraph: Hammer marks plus slag lobs; read the mark, then strike the smith.

frostbound_choirmaster.silhouette: Robed conductor ringed by a frozen choir.
frostbound_choirmaster.telegraph: Tolls of frost and rime lances; stay mobile between its casts.

drowned_crawler.silhouette: Dripping, low arachnid that scuttles in.
drowned_crawler.telegraph: No wind-up; strafe while attacking so it never lands a free hit.

tide_thrall.silhouette: Drowned caster trailing a bubbling wake.
tide_thrall.telegraph: Looses tide bolts at range; break line of sight or close fast.

gutter_king.telegraph: Telegraphed lunging charge; dodge the wind-up, then punish the recovery.

shrine_warden.telegraph: Charges and stamps a tide-slam zone; read both tells before you commit.

salt_hound.silhouette: Salt-crusted hound braced with bared teeth.
salt_hound.telegraph: Bites to inflict bleeding; space your retreat so the wound wears off.

mudlark_wrecker.silhouette: Ragged human wrecker with a coiled net.
mudlark_wrecker.telegraph: Throws a rooting net from range, then closes with a knife; dodge the throw.

barnacle_brute.telegraph: Telegraphed tide-slam AoE with knockback; leave the ring, then punish.
